title: FPS Creator
description:
THE CLASSIC NO-CODE FPS GAME MAKER IS BACKFPS Creator is a complete drag-and-drop game-making tool that lets you build your own first-person shooter games without writing a line of code.

Design your levels in the intuitive 3D editor, place walls, doors, lights, enemies, weapons, ammunition and interactive objects, then test your creation instantly with one click.

Whether you want to build a quick action-packed level, create a multi-stage adventure or experiment with classic 3D game design, FPS Creator gives you everything you need to get started.

LEGACY PRODUCT INFORMATIONFPS Creator is presented on Steam as a legacy game-development product.

As a legacy product, a couple of FPS Creator features are no longer supported—specifically, access to the original FPS Creator store and multiplayer functionality. All core features function out of the box.

Core functionality includes visual level construction, entity placement, enemies, weapons, physics, scripting, game testing and standalone game building.

FPS Creator retains the interface, workflow and visual character of its original era. Please review the system requirements before purchasing.

BUILD. POPULATE. PLAY.Creating a game with FPS Creator is simple:

• Build rooms, corridors and complete environments using the visual 3D editor
• Add doors, lighting, scenery and interactive objects
• Populate your levels with enemies, weapons and ammunition
• Press one button to enter your level and play
• Refine your design and test it again instantly

FPS Creator intelligently handles the connections between your game objects, allowing you to concentrate on designing and playing your game.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO START CREATINGFPS Creator includes a large collection of ready-to-use game content:

• More than 800 game objects
• 62 different enemies
• 18 weapons
• A full physics system
• Explosive and interactive objects
• Sounds, music and visual assets
• Support for up to 50 linked levels

Start with the included content and begin building immediately.

FULL PHYSICS AND INTERACTIVE WORLDSBring your levels to life with FPS Creator’s built-in physics system.

Create environments where objects can be moved, knocked over, thrown and destroyed. Add explosive objects, physical obstacles and interactive scenery to make every encounter feel more dynamic.

BUILD COMPLETE MULTI-LEVEL GAMESYour creation does not have to end with a single level.

Link together as many as 50 large levels to create longer adventures, connected environments and complete stories. Build everything from a compact survival challenge to an extended campaign.

SHARE IT. SELL IT. KEEP THE ROYALTIES.Turn your project into a standalone game that can be shared with friends or released commercially.

Games created with FPS Creator can be distributed royalty-free, allowing you to sell your finished creations without paying royalties on your sales.

THE CLASSIC RETURNSOriginally released in 2005, FPS Creator introduced aspiring developers around the world to the excitement of creating their own 3D games.

Now the original FPS Creator returns on Steam, preserved for existing fans, curious newcomers and anyone looking for a fast and approachable way to build classic first-person shooters.

FPS Creator retains the straightforward workflow and distinctive visual character of the original software.

BLACK ICE MOD

FPS Creator continues to be supported by a dedicated community of independent developers and creators.

Black Ice Mod is a community-developed enhancement for FPS Creator that expands and improves the original experience for users who want to take their projects further.

The standard version of FPS Creator functions out of the box, while Black Ice Mod provides an additional option for creators interested in exploring community-made improvements.  Black Ice Mod is an optional community-made modification and is not included with the standard Steam installation.
description_short: Create your game instantly with the intuitive 3D editor, drag and drop walls, lights, doors, enemies, ammo, weapons and more - with pixel perfect precision, and watch as they intelligently link together.  Then with one click of the mouse, play your game!
